title: The controller's untested URL-flag probes are deleted, with the helpers and state only they used
context: The refactor round's survey (2026-09-25-controller-dead-code-and-ratchets) left the opt-in URL-flag probe blocks of src/td-tab.js (~84 blocks, 3,064 lines then) as the remove-dead-code skill's flagged-experiment class, which needs the owner's confirmation. Owner, 2026-09-25: "yes on the url flag debug. we will fix later if further bugs are introduced".
outcome: Deleted every URL flag the controller read that no script, test or shareable doc uses: 96 keys, plus ?laser=1 (the suites use laser=online, a different read), ?mode=build and the ?ctl / ?ctlprobe log. The probes: beamfire, breachprobe, briefprobe, ctlprobe, deployprobe, downprobe, droneprobe, gestureprobe, ghostprobe (ghostwave), hangprobe, heartprobe, hoverprobe, modalprobe, modeprobe, pedprobe, plasmaprobe, pressprobe, printprobe, rankprobe, resetprobe, rockprobe, rosterprobe, sensorprobe, shieldprobe, shotprobe, shoveprobe, stickprobe, tapprobe, viewprobe, vpprobe, winprobe. The state jumps and demo overrides: a6 (a6post, a6kill, a6ram), alltowers, armed, audio, audiogate, autoup, beep, biomass (credit), callout, campaign, charge, coach, danger, debrief, drones, enemy (enemykill), found, garrison, goto, lose, map, newplanet, order (isao, bobby), perf, planet, points, rank, recoil, record, reveal, sector, shield, shieldrack, shop, sitrep, stress, strike, strikecam, strikefall, tankseen, terra, tick, tower, towerlook, towertier, view, wake, walk, wall, wave, whatsat. The hooks inside live code: ?driveout (the bays' load), ?viewlog (setView), ?vpbias (a fake visual viewport), ?autoplay (the briefing), ?mobbuild and ?pin (inside the kept ?layout ruler). With them went what only they used: placeTower, upgradeTower, probeKeyReaches, tankBeams, beamHitWall, lastToe, tfHulls, PEN_SOFT / PEN_HARD, the towerLookCtrl binding, viewOverride, vpFake, shieldProbeOn, CTL_DEBUG / ctlLog, showCallout's pin argument, twelve imports (each keeps another importer or a test) and towerlooks.js's setSentryTier / sentryPin. Kept: every key a suite uses on the game routes (acceptance, heart, look, creature, gunship, laser=online, blast, brief, fps, layout, keyprobe, sim, simfast, simcap, seed, mobile, coarse; the story keys are read by other modules), ?stateprobe (scripts/headless-wait.mjs) and what it reads, the ?mission read in run.start (a schema contract), the configuration reads that are not probes (metal, tier, sky, towerscale, callouts, walltops, viewwatch, diag, the SHIELD_TUNE knobs) and the radar scope's sensorDemo (test/radar-scope.mjs drives the proximity arcs through it). The briefing's debugging list keeps blast, laser, mode, brief, layout and sim; deeplink's DROP_KEYS loses the 13 keys whose reader is gone (tapprobe, pressprobe, modalprobe, stickprobe, breachprobe, pedprobe, sitrep, newplanet, driveout, whatsat, tick, walk, points). td-tab 12,696 -> 9,454 lines, 710,157 -> 537,879 bytes, 19 -> 19 lines over 500 characters; the budgets are lowered to match. One reach lost: ?enemy= was the URL way to put the shelved Mass (jelly) on the board; the acceptance adapter's spawnFodder(n, type) takes any type from the console.
alternatives: Keep the probes that document a past bug (?hangprobe, ?shotprobe, ?ctlprobe): rejected under the owner's yes; the bugs are in the log, and a probe no suite runs has not been checked since it was written.

Delete the configuration reads as well (?metal, ?tier, ?sky, ?towerscale, ?callouts, ?walltops, ?viewwatch, ?diag, the SHIELD_TUNE knobs): not probes; they set the product up (an owner-requested toggle, a render tier, the diagnostics panel the hearts also open, a tuning door), so they stay.
evidence: Key survey: every urlParams.get / URLSearchParams(...).get key in src/ (and td-tab's one regex read) matched as ?key / &key against scripts/*.mjs, test/*.mjs, the root pages and the current docs. The suites use exactly sw, acceptance, cine, world, stage, threat, heart, phase, story, skip, intro, gunship, roster, grow, fps, enemies, brief, tutorial, laser (online), creature, coarse, sim, simfast, simcap, seed, mobile, look, layout, landmarks, keyprobe, dev and blast on the game routes, and lab keys on the lab routes; scripts/headless-wait.mjs uses stateprobe; test/lab.mjs and test/url.mjs carry perf=2 and enemy=jelly:3 only as example strings for parseLabQuery and mergeHashQuery.

Every deleted top-level statement of initTdTab is a flag read, a flag-gated if or for, or a probe-only function (the one unconditional call, the tower-look panel control, stays): with no deleted flag in the URL the controller runs the code it ran before.

eslint no-undef / no-unused-vars of td-tab against main (the npx-cached eslint 10): no new undefined name; the 19 names the probes' removal left unused, and crossingForToe after them, were deleted; an argument-count diff of every local function found one parameter only the deleted code passed (showCallout's pin).
npm test (147 programs), npm run check (the architecture guard at the lowered budgets), node --check, npm run build, npm run log:check.

Browser battery through scripts/browser-lock.sh from a frozen copy of the code (commit e6eca24c), 19 suites, 273 steps, 0 failures: default 48, --story-world 31, --grow 16, --seats 3, --gunship 21, --missile-parity 2, --nav 10, --phone 12, --shield-story 6, --sectors 12, --backdoor 4, --back-gate 6, --skip-tutorial 7, --defense 12, --showcase 8, --laser-game 9, --quiver-frame 16, --waves 1, --dist 49 (the packed release).
